questions.q: Bihar's GSDP growth at current prices in 2024-25 (Bihar Economic Survey 2025-26) was:
questions.explanation: 13.1% at current prices; 8.6% at constant prices. India's current-price growth was 9.8%.

questions.q: Bihar's per-capita GSDP at current prices in 2024-25 was about:
questions.explanation: ₹76,490 (current); ₹40,973 at constant prices.

questions.q: Bihar was the first state to give women 50% reservation in panchayats, in:
questions.explanation: Bihar Panchayat Raj Act, 2006.

questions.q: Liquor prohibition in Bihar began on:
questions.explanation: Under the Bihar Prohibition and Excise Act, 2016.

questions.q: Which district is famous for Shahi Litchi (GI tag)?
questions.explanation: Shahi Litchi of Muzaffarpur got a GI tag in 2018.

questions.q: Bihar's 4th Agriculture Road Map covers:
Jeevika in Bihar is mainly a programme for:
questions.explanation: Bihar Rural Livelihoods Promotion Society, started 2006 with World Bank support.

questions.q: According to the Bihar caste survey (2023), the largest group was:
The Kosi river is known as:
questions.explanation: Because of frequent floods and shifting course.

questions.q: Bihar's first Ramsar site is:
questions.explanation: Kabartal was declared a Ramsar site in 2020.

questions.q: The APMC Act in Bihar was repealed in:
questions.explanation: Bihar abolished regulated mandis in 2006.

questions.q: Saat Nischay (first) was launched in:
questions.explanation: Saat Nischay-2 followed in 2020; Saat Nischay-3 frames the 2026-27 budget.

questions.q: Bihar's budget for 2026-27 is about:
questions.explanation: ₹3,47,589.76 crore, presented on 3 Feb 2026.

questions.q: Bihar's multidimensional poverty (NITI Aayog MPI 2023) fell from 51.89% to:
questions.explanation: 2015-16 to 2019-21; still the highest among states.

questions.q: Champaran Satyagraha took place in:
questions.explanation: Gandhi's first satyagraha in India.

questions.q: Bihar Provincial Kisan Sabha was founded by Swami Sahajanand Saraswati in:
questions.explanation: The All India Kisan Sabha was formed in 1936.

questions.q: Nalanda Mahavihara was founded by:
questions.explanation: Dharmapala founded Vikramshila.

questions.q: Urbanisation in Bihar (Census 2011) was about:
questions.explanation: Among the lowest in India.

questions.q: Bihar's outstanding debt on 31 March 2025 was about what share of GSDP?
questions.explanation: ₹3,74,134 crore = 37.7% of GSDP.

questions.q: In BPSC CCE Mains, General Hindi is:
questions.explanation: A minimum (reported 30 marks) is needed for other papers to be evaluated.
